# v0.8.0b8 — BMW port status, pause only with a car

Beta of the integration and app. **0.6.1 remains stable.** In service mode,
update the app to **0.8.0b8** first, then the integration.

Changes compared with 0.8.0b7:

- **BMW detection via the charging port status:** an i4 or i5 streams no plug
  boolean, only **Charging port status**. It now counts as the plug signal, so
  these cars offer detection from the vehicle and, with it, automatic vehicle
  selection. Previously only manual entities were offered.
- **A reached target pauses only with a car at the wallbox:** lowering the
  percentage target below the car's charge level while it is not plugged in no
  longer switches the pause on; the pause follows once a car is plugged in.
